VRChat · SPS · OSR

Connect VRChat / SPS and funscripts to OSR and other interactive devices.连接 VRChat / SPS 与 funscript，联动 OSR 等互动设备。

Use VRChat interactions, play a funscript or move a slider. Sensa turns your input into device motion, with the same workbench on desktop and in your browser.

用 VRChat 互动、funscript 脚本或手动滑条驱动设备。Sensa 把输入转换为设备动作，桌面版和网页版沿用同一套工作台操作。

Manual control & website bridges手动控制与网站联动

Try sliders in WebSensa, or let a supported app or website send controls through Sensa Desktop.

Start with one input and one device先连接一个输入和一台设备

  1. 1

    Open Sensa打开 Sensa

    Download the desktop app for VRChat and the full connection range. Open WebSensa for browser controls and scripts.

    VRChat 联动和完整连接使用桌面版；浏览器控制与脚本可直接打开 WebSensa。

  2. 2

    Add your device添加设备

    Add an output, choose your device and connection, then set its motion range.

    添加输出，选择设备与连接方式，再设置动作范围。

  3. 3

    Choose input, then enable it选择输入，再启用

    Choose OSC, a funscript or Manual. Enable the output and input when ready; emergency stop is always available.

    选择 OSC、funscript 或手动输入。准备好后启用输出与输入，随时可急停。

Devices, applications and bridges设备、应用与协议桥

Connect TCode/OSR, Intiface, Handy, Lovense, Autoblow, VacuGlide or DG-LAB. Send results over OSC, HTTP, WebSocket, MQTT or MIDI CC. WebSensa uses the serial, Bluetooth, MIDI, HTTP and WebSocket capabilities available in your browser.

连接 TCode／OSR、Intiface、Handy、Lovense、Autoblow、VacuGlide 或 DG-LAB；通过 OSC、HTTP、WebSocket、MQTT 或 MIDI CC 发送结果。WebSensa 使用浏览器可用的串口、蓝牙、MIDI、HTTP 与 WebSocket 连接。

Protocol inputs and website bridges →协议输入与网站桥接 →

Combine, record and replay组合输入、录制与回放

Combine inputs, smooth motion and send one result to several outputs. Record each binding as a funscript track; use JSON Lines or CSV for diagnostics.

组合输入、平滑动作，把一个结果送到多个输出。每条绑定可录制为 funscript 轨道，诊断数据可用 JSON Lines 或 CSV 保存。

Record and replay a track →录制与回放步骤 →

Unity avatar trackingUnity Avatar 定位
